FULL PRESCRIBING INFORMATION
3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS
Pravastatin sodium tablets, USP are supplied as:
30 mg tablets: light brown, mottled, round tablets, debossed with FL19 on one side
and plain on the other side.
60 mg tablets: light brown, mottled, capsule shape tablets, debossed with FL21 on
one side and plain on the other side.
